detail.longDescription: This is a web app that I built to introduce chess to my children, along with scratching a personal game analysis itch. I link to the games (free, ad free, tracker free, affiliate free, etc), though there is a full learning section as well that was my primary focus. I imagine many here already know the basics of chess. Of course I leveraged AI in all parts of this project -- and indeed the analysis section uses three separate neural networks to analyze play -- but never without full engagement and co-working between myself and the machine (I've been doing web apps for 30+ years), and all designs are my own. I contrived several of the games wholesale, though others are well trodden in the chess world. I use chess as a meditative beat from other engagements in my day to day, and have made it a personal mission to break out of the mediocre mid-tier play I've been stuck at for a few years. This has legitimately helped. I hope this provides some enrichment for others.
